what: 'Allowed but not obtained' overlooks ГК РФ ст. 1281 п. 4. For an author who was repressed and posthumously rehabilitated, the 70 years run from 1 January of the year after rehabilitation. She was shot in 1937 and rehabilitated 'in the 1950s', year not given. If that was 1956 or later, the translation is protected in Russia until the end of rehabilitation year + 70 (i.e. 2026–2029). Nothing is placed now, but the note's advice that an RSL scan 'would make all Book I places fillable' is not safe as written. Find the rehabilitation year first; until then, use short quotation only.
evidence: ГК РФ ст. 1281 п. 4 ('Если автор произведения был репрессирован и посмертно реабилитирован…'; zakonrf.info/gk/1281). SPbU religious-studies dictionary: shot 9 Oct 1937, 'rehabilitated in 1950-s' (relstud-hist.spbu.ru/en/articles/en-brullova-saskolskaa-nadezda-vladimirovna). Transitional rule 231-ФЗ ст. 6: a 50-year term running from 1957 had not expired by 1993.
